standard.summary: 留空则跟随启动器当前/上次 runtime。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Leave it blank to follow the launcher's current or most recent runtime.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 留空则跟随启动器当前/上次 runtime。仅当需要强制指定非启动环境时填写（如 flash2、sageattention）。填 standard 且启动环境非 standard 时，后端仍会继承启动环境。

advanced_en.principle: Empty = follow the launcher's current/last runtime. Fill in only to force a non-launcher environment (e.g. flash2, sageattention). If set to standard while the launch environment is not standard, the backend still inherits the launch environment.
